spl_product_data_elements: The Zoeun Skin Total Conditioner Sturgeon extract TOCOPHEROL FRAGRANCE 13576 STURGEON, UNSPECIFIED STURGEON, UNSPECIFIED
purpose: Purposes Skin Protectant, Total Skin Care
indications_and_usage: Uses Skin Moisturizing, Brightening, Wrinkle Care
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Warnings Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
stop_use: Warnings Stop using and ask a doctor if irritation or rash appears and lasts.
when_using: Warnings When using this product keep out of eyes. Rinse with water to remove.
dosage_and_administration: Directions • All ages can use. • Whenever wish to, apply directly to the skin, and let the skin absorb without wiping.
